decisions.statement: A wrapper capping its width by its family's available width names the tag judged.
A wrapper is found wherever that wrapper is written rather than in a package named here.
A wrapper setting no collision padding names no tag.
A max-w token on a named tag replaces the cap rather than joining the cap.
A max-w with a calc is left.
The cap is reachable inside a max-w with a calc.
A className a call builds is read through to the strings that call has.
Turning collisions off and closing the collision padding are refused on those tags.
A tag two wrappers give two families refuses the check.
A tree where no wrapper caps refuses the check rather than reporting clean.
The tags judged are read from the files a search of the tree names and the change's own files.
Each of those files is read as the change leaves that file.
A change to a wrapper's cap judges the files that change carries and no other.
A file using that wrapper is judged when that file is next changed or at audit.

definition: the check refusing a popover whose class or prop undoes the viewport cap its wrapper sets
